Class SysMLStateMachine.DefaultEventComparator

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.states.SysMLStateMachine.DefaultEventComparator
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparator<SysMLEvent>
Enclosing class:
SysMLStateMachine
public class SysMLStateMachine.DefaultEventComparator extends Object implements Comparator<SysMLEvent>
SysMLinJava default implementation of the Comparator<SysMLEvent> interface used by the event queue to prioritize events in the SysMLStateMachine's event queue. This default comparator gives all events equal priority, i.e. no prioritization of events. The event comparator is set in the createEventComparator() operation. This operation can/should be overridden in extended classes to initialize the eventComparator with a specialized event comparator if/when event prioritization of events is needed.
